Package neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline

Class WellToTopsideSlugControlStudy

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.WellToTopsideSlugControlStudy
public final class WellToTopsideSlugControlStudy extends Object
Reproducible wellhead-choke, flowline/riser and inlet-separator slug-control study.

The pipe uses the fixed pressure outlet qualified by the #5036 regression. The separator pressure controller is independently centred on that pressure. Updating the pipe pressure boundary from the live separator pressure is deliberately excluded: that API route is not covered by the fixed-boundary phase-ownership qualification and can suppress liquid through-flow after millibar-scale boundary changes.

1.0
Author:
